advisory_banner.headline: CRITICAL DEPLOYMENT ADVISORY (All Cycles): 5 Windows Update(s) (KB5124008, KB5044284, KB5120998, KB5122880, KB5122878) have confirmed severe regressions or Out-of-Band (OOB) replacements.
advisory_banner.detail: Pause broad deployment of KB5124008, KB5044284, KB5120998, KB5122880, KB5122878. Click any KB, OOB replacement, or Known Issue Rollback (KIR) link below to inspect the deployment rationale and mitigation policy.
